notes.title: Announcement: "Sakura Segment 1.0" New Release Schedule
notes.content:
Hello,

We apologize for the delay in updating you. Due to the review process taking longer than anticipated, "Sakura Segment 1.0" is now scheduled for a release in either January or February 2024. We're committed to ensuring it meets our quality standards. Thank you for your patience and support.

Note: Sakura Segment 1.0" is an entirely new title, not an update to our previous games.

Warm regards,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42946499/0da0816f44f8f0005fb96fe43092105c29829bee.png[/img]
